definitions.explanation: A steep rock face, especially at the edge of the sea or a mountain.

examples.japanese: {断崖|だんがい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{上|うえ}→上：00682_ue⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{景色|けしき}→景色：01395_keshiki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{絶景|ぜっけい}→絶景：16835_zekkei⟧⟦だった→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: The view from the top of the cliff was spectacular.

examples.japanese: ⟦{波|なみ}→波：00868_nami⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{断崖|だんがい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{打|う}ちつけていた→打ちつける：16631_uchitsukeru⟧。
examples.english: Waves were crashing against the cliff.

examples.japanese: {断崖|だんがい}⟦{絶壁|ぜっぺき}→絶壁：16412_zeppeki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{慎重|しんちょう}に→慎重：03264_shinchou⟧⟦{歩|ある}いた→歩く：00538_aruku⟧。
examples.english: I walked carefully along the path on the sheer cliff.

notes:
{断崖|だんがい} refers to a steep cliff or precipice. {断|だん} means 'cut off/sheer' and {崖|がい} means 'cliff.'

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {断崖|だんがい}⟦{絶壁|ぜっぺき}→絶壁：16412_zeppeki⟧: sheer cliff, precipice
- {断崖|だんがい}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{落|お}ちる→落ちる：01242_ochiru⟧: to fall from a cliff
- ⟦{海|うみ}→海：00556_umi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{断崖|だんがい}: sea cliff
- {断崖|だんがい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{登|のぼ}る→登る：00660_noboru⟧: to climb a cliff

USAGE:
- {断崖|だんがい}⟦{絶壁|ぜっぺき}→絶壁：16412_zeppeki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{立|た}つ→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧: to stand on the edge (of disaster)
- ⟦{崖|がけ}っぷち→崖っぷち：16343_gakeppuchi⟧: on the brink/edge

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{崖|がけ}→崖：05391_gake⟧: cliff (more common in speech)
- ⟦{絶壁|ぜっぺき}→絶壁：16412_zeppeki⟧: precipice, steep cliff
- ⟦{岩壁|がんぺき}→岩壁：noentry⟧: rock wall
